component.name: RadioKit
component.summary: BLE & USB Serial companion app for Arduino RadioKit library

description.p: RadioKit is an open-source companion app for the Arduino RadioKit library. It provides a rich set of customizable widgets — buttons, sliders, knobs, joysticks, gauges, and more — that communicate with microcontrollers over BLE or USB serial.
Design control panels visually on your phone or desktop, then control your Arduino projects wirelessly or over USB with zero coding required for the UI.
